title: Ride from Kyzart to Kilemche
desc: The tour begins in Kyzart Village, the closest settlement to Song-Kol. After your guide runs through the basics in the saddle, you set off at an easy pace along the Chaar-Archa River, letting horse and rider get used to one another across wide, gentle valleys.

A picnic lunch by the water breaks up the day before you carry on toward Kilemche. By evening you reach a yurt camp kept by a herder family, time to wander the surrounding hills, watch the rhythm of nomad life, and settle in before dinner.

title: Over Jalgyz-Karagai Pass to Song-Kol
desc: Today asks more of you. After breakfast you climb steadily toward the Jalgyz-Karagai Pass at 3300 m, with the mountains opening up around you the higher you go. From the top comes your first glimpse of Song-Kol lying far below.

You drop down to a lakeside yurt camp for lunch, then ride west along the shore in the afternoon, passing grazing herds and scattered yurts on your way to the Tuz-Ashuu pasture. The evening is yours by the water, and on a clear night the stars are something to see.

title: Back over Tuz-Ashuu Pass to Kyzart
desc: After saying goodbye to your host family, you ride back toward the Tuz-Ashuu Pass at 3300 m. The climb is gradual, and from the top you take in Song-Kol one last time, ringed by open pasture and high peaks.
From there a pretty trail carries you down toward Kyzart. Lunch and a rest at the guesthouse round off your time in the saddle before the tour comes to a close.
meals: Breakfast at yurt, lunch at guesthouse
